ROSE：NL2SQL 以意图为中心的评估指标ROSE: An Intent-Centered Evaluation Metric for NL2SQL

Wenqi Pei1,2,, Shizheng Hou2,11footnotemark: 1, Boyan Li1,11footnotemark: 1, Han Chen2, Zhichao Shi1, Yuyu Luo1,

1 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
2 National University of Singapore Equal Contribution.Corresponding author.
摘要Abstract

执行准确性 (EX) 是广泛用于评估自然语言到 SQL (NL2SQL) 解决方案有效性的指标，但它正变得越来越不可靠。它对语法变化很敏感，忽略了问题可能接受多种解释，并且很容易被错误的真实 SQL 误导。为了解决这个问题，我们引入Execution Accuracy (EX), the widely used metric for evaluating the effectiveness of Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) solutions, is becoming increasingly unreliable. It is sensitive to syntactic variation, ignores that questions may admit multiple interpretations, and is easily misled by erroneous ground-truth SQL. To address this, we introduce玫瑰ROSE，一个以意图为中心的指标，重点关注预测的 SQL 是否回答了问题，而不是与参考依赖范式下的真实 SQL 的一致性。 ROSE 采用对抗性 Prover-Refuter 级联：SQL Prover 根据用户意图独立评估预测 SQL 的语义正确性，而 Adversarial Refuter 使用真实 SQL 作为证据来挑战和完善这一判断。在我们专家一致的验证集上, an intent-centered metric that focuses on whether the predicted SQL answers the question, rather than consistency with the ground-truth SQL under the reference-dependent paradigm. ROSE employs an adversarial Prover-Refuter cascade: SQL Prover assesses the semantic correctness of a predicted SQL against the user’s intent independently, while Adversarial Refuter uses the ground-truth SQL as evidence to challenge and refine this judgment. On our expert-aligned validation set玫瑰血管内皮细胞ROSE-VEC，ROSE 与人类专家达到了最佳一致性，比 Cohen 的 Kappa 的次优指标高出近 24%。我们还对 19 种 NL2SQL 方法进行了大规模的重新评估，揭示了四个有价值的见解。我们发布 ROSE 和 ROSE-VEC 以促进更可靠的 NL2SQL 研究, ROSE achieves the best agreement with human experts, outperforming the next-best metric by nearly 24% in Cohen’s Kappa. We also conduct a large-scale re-evaluation of 19 NL2SQL methods, revealing four valuable insights. We release ROSE and ROSE-VEC to facilitate more reliable NL2SQL research111https://github.com/CedricPei/ROSE.

1 简介Introduction

Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) 将用户问题转换为给定数据库上可执行的 SQL 查询Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) translates user questions into executable SQL queries over a given databaseLuo et al. (2025); Liu et al. (2025a); Zhu et al. (2026)并支持一系列数据分析任务and supports a range of data analysis tasksZhang et al. (2020); Luo et al. (2018a, b)。在功能日益强大的大型语言模型 (LLM) 的推动下，NL2SQL 最近取得了显着的进展. Recent progress in NL2SQL has been remarkable, driven by increasingly capable large language models (LLMs)Li et al. (2026); Zhu et al. (2025); Zhang et al. (2025); Pei et al. (2025)。然而，这种快速增长暴露了一个关键瓶颈：现有的评估指标很难捕捉到预测的 SQL 在语义上是否符合用户的意图。. However, this rapid growth has exposed a key bottleneck: existing evaluation metrics struggle to capture whether the predicted SQL is semantically correct with respect to the user’s intentLi et al. (2024a); Hou et al. (2026).

该领域的核心指标“执行准确性”(EX) 仅当预测的 SQL 执行结果与单个真实 SQL 匹配时才认为其正确。这种表面层检查导致 EX 在三种重复出现的情况下不可靠：(i) 当底层逻辑相同时（例如，投影顺序、值格式），实现差异。 EX 无法适应不同输出表示的此类预测。结构审计报告的漏报率高达 28.9%，原因是不规范但正确的表格The core metric in the field, Execution Accuracy (EX), deems a predicted SQL correct only when its execution result matches a single ground-truth SQL. This surface-level check causes EX to be unreliable in three recurring cases: (i) Realization variance when the underlying logic is identical (e.g., projection order, value formatting). EX cannot accommodate such predictions across different output representations. Structural audits report false negatives up to 28.9% caused by non-canonical but correct formsAscoli et al. (2024); (ii) 对模棱两可的问题有多种有效的解释。 EX 错过了这些偏离真实 SQL 的合理预测，但仍然正确回答了问题。豚草属; (ii) Multiple valid interpretations for ambiguous questions. EX misses these reasonable predictions that deviate from the ground-truth SQL but still correctly answer the question. AmbrosiaSaparina and Lapata (2024)报告称，超过一半的失败源于含糊不清，而 Sphinteractreports that more than half of failures arise from ambiguity, and SphinteractZhao et al. (2025b)进一步强调了问题的严重性； (iii) 大规模基准测试中错误的真实 SQL。 EX 将这些注释错误传播到所有评估的预测。 NL2SQL-BUGfurther underscores the severity of the problem; (iii) Erroneous ground-truth SQL in large-scale benchmarks. EX propagates these annotation errors to all evaluated predictions. NL2SQL-BUGsLiu et al. (2025b)BIRD Dev 上报告的真实 SQL 错误率为 6.91%。在我们的审计中，大约 25% 的抽样项目被至少一名注释者标记为错误。这些问题表明 EX 倾向于匹配特定的参考 SQL，而不是实现问题背后的意图。reports a 6.91% ground-truth SQL error rate on BIRD Dev. In our audit, approximately 25% of sampled items were flagged as wrong by at least one annotator. These issues indicate that EX favors matching a particular reference SQL rather than achieving the intent behind the question.

已经提出了一些改进的指标。结构感知措施Several improved metrics have been proposed. Structure-aware measuresAscoli et al. (2024); Zhan et al. (2025)通过复杂的标准化允许语法级别的变体，这减少了表面的不匹配，但仍然判断与参考的接近程度，而不是判断预测是否回答了问题的语义。法学硕士法官allow for syntax-level variants via complex normalization, which reduces superficial mismatches, but still judges proximity to a reference rather than whether the prediction answers the question’s semantics. LLM-based judgesKim et al. (2025); Zhao et al. (2025a)提高与专家评估的一致性，但大多数协议仍然依赖于参考，主要针对单个真实 SQL 检查一致性。他们对合法歧义的容忍度不够，并且很容易被有缺陷的真实 SQL 误导。鉴于这些限制，转向较少依赖于参考的评估的范式转变变得可取。improve alignment with expert assessments, but most protocols remain reference-dependent, checking consistency primarily against a single ground-truth SQL. They are insufficiently tolerant of legitimate ambiguity and are easily misled by the flawed ground-truth SQL. In light of these limitations, a paradigm shift toward less reference-dependent evaluation is becoming advisable.

因此，我们介绍Therefore, we introduce玫瑰ROSE (REASeasO宁ningS科尔corE）。它是一个新的指标，旨在衡量问题的潜在意图与预测所体现的推理过程之间的一致性。这种以意图为中心的评估是通过推理模型驱动的 Prover-Refuter 级联实现的。的). It is a new metric designed to measure the consistency between the underlying intent of the question and the reasoning process embodied by the prediction. This intent-centered evaluation is realized via a Prover-Refuter cascade powered by reasoning models. TheSQL验证器SQL Prover仅使用问题和数据库信息做出独立判断，而不访问真实的 SQL。的makes an independent judgment using only the question and the database information, without accessing the ground-truth SQL. The对抗性反驳者Adversarial Refuter，可以访问真实的 SQL，将其视为挑战证明者接受的证据，将其与预测进行对比，以暴露决定性的不匹配。通过这种分析，它还可以将案例标记为不明确的问题或基本事实错误。这种级联减少了参考锚定，同时缓和了过度宽容并暴露了数据集问题。, with access to the ground-truth SQL, treats it as evidence to challenge the Prover’s acceptance, contrasting it with the prediction to expose decisive mismatches. Through this analysis, it can also tag cases as ambiguous questions or ground-truth errors. This cascade reduces reference anchoring while tempering over-permissiveness and exposes dataset issues.

我们构建We construct玫瑰血管内皮细胞ROSE-VEC, 一个, aV验证数据集alidation dataset withE专家xpertC评估度量有效性的共识。在此数据集上，ROSE 的一致性比最接近的竞争对手高出 24%，准确度高出 14%，表现出与用户意图的更好一致性。onsensus to assess metric validity. On this dataset, ROSE outperforms the closest competitor by 24% in agreement and 14% in accuracy, demonstrating better alignment with user intent.

在 ROSE 的基础上，我们对 19 种 NL2SQL 方法进行了大规模的重新评估。我们的分析得出了四个关键见解：（i）基础模型功能，而不是系统级工程，是主要的性能驱动因素； (ii) 随着模型的进步，语义正确性和参考匹配之间的差距不断扩大，标志着评估危机； (iii) 这种差异主要源于基准缺陷，即事实真相错误和问题模糊性； (iv) 微调通过使模型与数据集的风格约定保持一致来缩小这一差距。Building on ROSE, we perform a large-scale re-evaluation of 19 NL2SQL methods. Our analysis yields four key insights: (i) Base model capability, not system-level engineering, is the primary performance driver; (ii) As models advance, a widening gap between semantic correctness and reference matching signals an evaluation crisis; (iii) This divergence largely stems from benchmark flaws, namely ground-truth errors and question ambiguities; and (iv) Fine-tuning narrows this gap by aligning models to a dataset’s stylistic conventions.

我们的贡献总结如下：We summarize our contributions as follows:

  • •

    我们引入了 ROSE，这是一种以意图为中心的 NL2SQL 评估指标，它利用对抗性 Prover-Refuter 级联，实现与专家判断的最佳一致性。We introduce ROSE, an intent-centered metric for NL2SQL evaluation that leverages an adversarial Prover-Refuter cascade, achieving the best agreement with expert judgment.

  • •

    我们构建并发布了 ROSE-VEC，这是一个包含 585 个专家共识样本的验证数据集，配有详细的注释，以实现对 NL2SQL 指标的严格验证。We construct and release ROSE-VEC, a validation dataset of 585 expert-consensus samples, complete with detailed annotations, to enable rigorous validation of NL2SQL metrics.

  • •

    我们对 19 种方法进行了大规模的重新评估，提炼出了四个关键见解，为未来的 NL2SQL 研究提供了重要指导。We conduct a large-scale re-evaluation of 19 methods, distilling four key insights that provide important guidance for future NL2SQL research.

3 相关工作Related Work

NL2SQL 的评估已经发生了显着的变化。我们将评估指标分为两种主要类型：确定性指标和基于 LLM 的指标。指标的正式数学定义可在附录中找到The evaluation of NL2SQL has evolved significantly. We categorize the landscape of evaluation metrics into two primary types: deterministic metrics and LLM-based metrics. The formal mathematical definitions for the metrics are available in the AppendixA.

3.1 确定性指标Deterministic Metrics

确定性指标使用预定义的、基于规则的算法评估查询的正确性，形成标准 NL2SQL 基准测试的基础。Deterministic metrics evaluate query correctness using predefined, rule-based algorithms, forming the foundation of standard NL2SQL benchmarks.

3.2 基于法学硕士的指标LLM-based Metrics

出现了一种新的评估类型，它采用大型语言模型（LLM）作为语义判断器来评估查询的正确性。与确定性指标不同，这种方法旨在利用法学硕士的推理能力来提供更现实的效用衡量标准。A new evaluation type has emerged that employs Large Language Models (LLMs) as semantic judges to assess query correctness. Unlike deterministic metrics, this approach aims to leverage the reasoning capabilities of LLMs to provide a more realistic measure of utility.

4.2 对抗性反驳者Adversarial Refuter

然而，SQL Prover 完全独立于事实真相的风险是过于宽容，无法利用内部的信号（尽管有噪音）。However, SQL Prover’s complete independence from the ground-truth risks being overly permissive, failing to leverage signals (albeit noisy) withinSgS_{g}。因此，我们引入对抗性驳斥者。它使用. Hence, we introduce Adversarial Refuter. It usesSgS_{g}不是作为匹配的参考，而是作为挑战并可能反驳 SQL Prover 对 SQL Prover 的肯定判断的证据来源not as a reference to match, but as a source of evidence to challenge and potentially refute SQL Prover’s affirmative judgment onSpS_{p}.

4.2.1 Ep≡EgE_{p}\equiv E_{g}：抑制误报: Suppressing False Positives

当执行结果匹配时，SQL Prover 会被绕过，而 Refuter 则充当关键的防护措施。通过直接比较推理When execution results match, SQL Prover is bypassed, and the Refuter acts as a critical safeguard. By directly comparing the reasoning ofSpS_{p}和andSgS_{g}，它识别巧合正确性的情况。这可以防止因有缺陷的预测而出现误报，并且同样重要的是，可以防止标记错误, it identifies cases of coincidental correctness. This prevents false positives from a flawed prediction and, just as importantly, labeling erroneousSgS_{g}.

4.2.2 Ep≢EgE_{p}\not\equiv E_{g}: 具有挑战性的 SQL Prover: Challenging SQL Prover

在 SQL Prover 批准的情况下In cases where SQL Prover approvesSpS_{p}尽管despiteEpE_{p}与 冲突conflicting withEgE_{g}，对抗性驳斥者仲裁冲突。它指出了推理之间的语义分歧, Adversarial Refuter arbitrates the conflict. It pinpoints the semantic divergence between the reasoning ofSpS_{p}和andSgS_{g}。然后，它根据用户的意图重新评估这种差异. It then re-evaluates this divergence against the user’s intent inQQ以确定哪种逻辑更可靠。该仲裁可能会驳回 SQL Prover 的批准，标志to determine which logic is more faithful. This arbitration may refute SQL Prover’s approval, flagSgS_{g}视为错误，或接受这两个查询作为对不明确问题的有效解释as erroneous, or accept both queries as valid interpretations of an ambiguous questionQQ.

4.3 玫瑰ROSE

ROSE是由如图所示的工作流程确定的ROSE is determined by the workflow illustrated in Figure1。预测的 SQL 必须首先是可执行的。如果其执行结果与真实SQL不同，则必须通过SQL Prover的独立评估。最后，它必须经受住来自对抗性驳斥者的对抗性挑战，后者使用事实真相作为反证。这些阶段中任何一个阶段的失败都会导致得分为 0。只有成功导航整个级联的查询才能获得最终得分 1。ROSE 的数学定义在附录中. A predicted SQL must first be executable. If its execution result differs from the ground-truth SQL, it must pass SQL Prover’s independent evaluation. Finally, it must withstand the adversarial challenge from Adversarial Refuter, which uses the ground-truth as counter-evidence. Failure at any of these stages results in a score of 0. Only a query that successfully navigates this entire cascade earns a final score of 1. The mathematical definition for ROSE is in AppendixB与其他 NL2SQL 指标的比较见附录and its comparison with other NL2SQL metrics is in AppendixC.

5.1.2 验证指标Validation Metrics

我们评估 NL2SQL 指标和专家标签之间的一致性，将“正确”视为肯定类别。我们报告了四个验证指标，其公式推迟到附录中We evaluate agreement between NL2SQL metrics and expert labels, treating “correct” as the positive class. We report four validation metrics, with formulations deferred to AppendixD.

科恩的卡帕（Cohen’s Kappa (κ\kappa) Cohen (1960)是我们的主要指标。它衡量了超越偶然的一致性，并且在偏态分布下具有稳健性。is our primary metric. It measures agreement beyond chance and is robust under skewed distributions.

准确度（ACC）Accuracy (ACC)是正确判断实例的比例。它很容易解释，但当类别不平衡时可能会产生误导。is the proportion of correctly judged instances. It is simple to interpret but can be misleading when the classes are imbalanced.

马修斯相关系数 (MCC)Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) Matthews (1975)是真实标签和预测标签之间的相关系数，当类别大小差异很大时，该相关系数是可靠的。is a correlation coefficient between ground-truth and predicted labels that is reliable when class sizes differ substantially.

F1 van Rijsbergen (1979)是正类的精确率和召回率的调和平均值，用于评估法官识别有效 SQL 查询的能力。is the harmonic mean of precision and recall on the positive class, assessing how well a judge identifies valid SQL queries.

6.2 见解Insights

6.2.1 基础模型优势Base Model Dominance

我们揭示了一个基本原则：We reveal a foundational principle:

这种层次结构在图中直观可见This hierarchy is visually evident in Figure2，其中系统集群成由其基本模型定义的不同性能层。性能随着模型生成而单调扩展，从 GPT-3.5、GPT-4 和 GPT-4o，到 GPT-5，工程系统继承了这种顺序。例如，基于 GPT-4o 的 RSL-SQL 在两个指标上都优于基于 GPT-3.5 的 C3-SQL。这种模式也适用于微调模型：在类似的 30B 规模下，基于 Qwen2.5 构建的 OmniSQL 超越了 CHESS, where systems cluster into distinct performance tiers defined by their base model. Performance scales monotonically with model generation, from GPT-3.5, through GPT-4 and GPT-4o, to GPT-5, and engineered systems inherit this ordering. For example, RSL-SQL based on GPT-4o outperforms C3-SQL based on GPT-3.5 in both metrics. This pattern also holds for fine-tuned models: at a similar 30B scale, OmniSQL built on Qwen2.5 surpasses CHESS（红外、不锈钢、CG）(IR,SS,CG)在 DeepSeek-Coder 上。on DeepSeek-Coder.

我们还注意到，一些系统落后于它们的基本模型（例如，GPT-4 超越了 DAIL-SQL）。出现这种差异的原因是我们的基线使用最新模型，而系统的公共结果是使用早期版本生成的。这强化了我们的发现，即最近的性能提升很大程度上归因于更强大的基础模型。因此，未来的评估必须将系统设计与模型更新脱钩，以准确地将真正的算法改进归因于模型缩放之外。We also note that several systems trail their base models (e.g., GPT-4 surpasses DAIL-SQL). This discrepancy arises because our baselines use the latest model, while the systems’ public results were generated with earlier versions. This reinforces our finding that recent performance gains are overwhelmingly attributable to stronger base models. It is therefore imperative that future evaluations decouple system design from model updates to accurately attribute true algorithmic improvements beyond model scaling.

6.2.2 差距扩大Widening Gap

基于这一原则，我们的分析揭示了一个关键的悖论：Building on the principle, our analysis uncovers a critical paradox:

如图所示As illustrated in Figure3，ROSE（以意图为中心）和 EX（依赖参考）之间的提示方法之间的差距随着时间的推移而急剧扩大。这一趋势十分明显：从 2023 年中期开始，这一差距还不到 5%，但从预计到 2025 年中期的模型来看，这一差距将扩大到 20% 以上。, the gap between ROSE (intent-centered) and EX (reference-dependent) for prompting methods widens dramatically over time. The trend is stark: the gap was less than 5% with systems from mid-2023, but balloons to more than 20% with models projected for mid-2025.

这种日益扩大的分歧是由两个复合因素驱动的。首先，错误的性质发生了变化。早期的系统经常生成语义上不正确的 SQL，其中两个指标都会一致认为失败，从而保持较小的差距。随着方法的进步，生成语义正确但由于其缺点或错误的真实 SQL 而被 EX 标记为错误的 SQL 的情况越来越常见。 ROSE在这种情况下对有效的解决方案做出了正确的判断，从而扩大了差距。其次，更强的模型表现出更大的表达自由度，生成更广泛的语义正确但风格多样的 SQL。 ROSE 奖励这种语义能力，而 EX 则惩罚它，从而扩大了差异。This growing divergence is driven by two compounding factors. First, the nature of errors changes. Early systems often produced semantically incorrect SQL, where both metrics would agree on the failure, keeping the gap small. As methods advance, it is increasingly common to generate SQL that is semantically correct yet flagged wrong by EX due to its shortcomings or erroneous ground-truth SQL. ROSE gives correct judgment for valid solutions in such cases, thus widening the gap. Second, stronger models exhibit greater expressive freedom, generating a wider variety of semantically correct but stylistically diverse SQL. ROSE rewards this semantic competence, while EX punishes it, inflating the difference.

这一趋势得出了一个结论：社区正面临度量危机。不断扩大的差距不仅仅是一个统计假象，而且是一个明确的信号，表明在强大的生成模型时代，严格的参考匹配评估正在变得过时。这表明迫切需要一个以意图为中心的指标来衡量该领域的真实进展。This trend delivers a verdict: the community is facing a metric crisis. The widening gap is not merely a statistical artifact, but a clear signal that rigid reference-matching evaluations are becoming obsolete in the era of powerful generative models. This points to the urgent need for an intent-centered metric that can measure true progress in the field.

6.2.3 基准缺陷Benchmark Flaws

为了查明这些因素，我们使用 ROSE 的诊断标签来隔离这些有问题的子集的不一致率。表中提供的证据To pinpoint these factors, we use ROSE’s diagnostic labels to isolate the discordance rate on these problematic subsets. The evidence presented in Table4是结论性的。对于错误的真实 SQL (GoldX) 问题，在所有测试系统中，两个指标之间的不一致率飙升至 80% 以上。对于模棱两可的问题 (AmbQ)，该比例仍然非常高，约为 60%。这两个比率都远远超过整个数据集中不到 20% 的平均分歧，证实这些数据集问题是指标分歧的重要催化剂。is conclusive. For questions with erroneous ground-truth SQL (GoldX), the disagreement rate between the two metrics skyrockets to over 80% across all tested systems. For ambiguous questions (AmbQ), it remains exceptionally high at around 60%. Both rates far eclipse the average disagreement of less than 20% in the overall dataset, confirming that these dataset issues are a significant catalyst for metric divergence.

图Figure4表明这两个罪魁祸首是分歧的主要根源。 GoldX 和 AmbQ 始终约占不一致案例的 45% 和 10%，共同解释了 EX 和 ROSE 分歧的一半以上情况。因此，提高未来数据集的清晰度和正确性对于使 EX 成为用户意图的忠实代理至关重要。这也强调了识别基准缺陷的迫切需要。shows that these two culprits are the dominant source of disagreements. GoldX and AmbQ consistently account for roughly 45% and 10% of discordant cases, collectively explaining more than half of instances where EX and ROSE diverge. Thus, improving the clarity and correctness of future datasets is essential for making EX a faithful proxy for user intent. This also underscores the critical need to identify benchmark flaws.

6.2.4 微调效果Fine-Tuning Effect

相比之下，微调似乎可以缓解不断扩大的差距。我们的分析表明这是一种对齐效应：In contrast, fine-tuning appears to alleviate the widening gap. Our analysis reveals that this is an alignment effect:

这种现象在图中进行了量化This phenomenon is quantified in Figure5，这表明提示方法在所有难度级别上始终表现出较大的差距。这种差异在简单和中等问题上尤其明显，其中提示的差距大约是微调方法的四倍。, which shows that prompting methods consistently exhibit a larger gap across all difficulty levels. The difference is particularly obvious on Simple and Moderate questions, where the gap for prompting is roughly four times that of fine-tuned methods.

根本原因是大多数微调方法都是在 BIRD Train 上训练的，有效地学习模仿 SQL 风格。异常值强化了这一点：OmniSQL 主要在庞大的语料库 (SynSQL) 上进行训练，显示出更大的指标差距。相反，CodeS和CHESS等方法The underlying cause is that most fine-tuned methods are trained on BIRD Train, effectively learning to mimic the SQL style. This is reinforced by the outlier: OmniSQL, primarily trained on a huge corpus (SynSQL), shows a larger metric gap. Conversely, methods such as CodeS and CHESS（红外、不锈钢、CG）(IR,SS,CG)，它可能会过度拟合噪声或有限的训练数据，甚至可以实现比 ROSE 更高的 EX。, which can potentially overfit noisy or limited training data, can even achieve higher EX than ROSE.

相反，提示方法缺乏这种特定于数据集的条件。它们生成语义正确但风格多样的更广泛多样性的 SQL。虽然 ROSE 正确地认可了这种多样性，但 EX 严格的参考匹配会惩罚这些变化，这解释了此类方法观察到的始终较大的差距。In contrast, prompting methods lack this dataset-specific conditioning. They generate a wider diversity of semantically correct, yet stylistically varied, SQL. While ROSE correctly credits this diversity, EX’s rigid reference matching penalizes these variations, which explains the consistently larger gap observed for this class of methods.

7 结论Conclusion

在这项工作中，我们通过引入 ROSE 来解决 NL2SQL 评估中日益严重的危机，ROSE 是一种以意图为中心的指标，利用对抗性的 Prover-Refuter 级联来实现与专家判断的高度一致。我们在 ROSE-VEC 上证明了其有效性，ROSE-VEC 是我们公开发布的包含 585 个专家注释样本的数据集，其性能大大优于现有指标。In this work, we addressed the growing crisis in NL2SQL evaluation by introducing ROSE, an intent-centered metric that leverages an adversarial Prover-Refuter cascade to achieve superior alignment with expert judgment. We demonstrated its effectiveness on ROSE-VEC, our publicly released dataset of 585 expert-annotated samples, where it substantially outperforms existing metrics.

我们的重新评估为社区带来了四点见解。首先，基础模型相对于系统工程的主导地位要求重新评估新颖算法贡献的构成。其次，ROSE 和 EX 之间不断扩大的差距迫切要求超越依赖参考的评估。第三，我们发现这种差距主要是由可解决的基准缺陷造成的，即错误的真实 SQL 和问题模糊性。最后，我们的分析表明，对当前训练集的微调可能是在教授风格一致性，而不是改善语义推理。Our re-evaluation yielded four insights for the community. First, the dominance of base models over system engineering calls for a re-evaluation of what constitutes a novel algorithmic contribution. Second, the widening gap between ROSE and EX serves as an urgent call to move beyond reference-dependent evaluation. Third, we identified that this gap is primarily caused by addressable benchmark flaws, namely erroneous ground-truth SQL and question ambiguity. Finally, our analysis suggests that fine-tuning on the current training set may be teaching stylistic conformity rather than improving semantic reasoning.

这些见解凸显了社区迫切需要优先开发更强大、以意图为中心的评估指标，并专注于提高数据集的质量和清晰度。 ROSE 开创的范式不仅为 NL2SQL 提供了一条有希望的前进道路，而且还可能为其他复杂任务提供了一条有前途的道路，在这些任务中，成功应该通过满足用户意图来定义，而不是匹配单个、可能有缺陷的真实解决方案。为了真正衡量和指导强大的生成模型时代的进步，我们必须发展我们的评估方法。These insights highlight the urgent need for the community to prioritize the development of more robust and intent-centered evaluation metrics and to focus on improving the quality and clarity of datasets. The paradigm pioneered by ROSE offers a promising path forward, not only for NL2SQL, but potentially for other complex tasks where success should be defined by fulfilling user intent rather than matching a single, potentially flawed ground-truth solution. To truly measure and guide progress in the era of powerful generative models, we must evolve our methods of evaluation.

局限性Limitations

虽然 ROSE 为 NL2SQL 引入了更强大、以意图为中心的评估范例，但我们承认有一些限制需要在未来的工作中考虑。While ROSE introduces a more robust, intent-centered evaluation paradigm for NL2SQL, we acknowledge several limitations that warrant consideration for future work.

对基础法学硕士的依赖。Dependency on Foundational LLMs.ROSE 的功效与其底层 LLM 的推理能力有着内在的联系。如表所示The efficacy of ROSE is intrinsically linked to the reasoning capabilities of its underlying LLM. As demonstrated in Table1，当使用不同的基础模型作为 SQL Prover 和 Adversarial Refuter 的骨干时，性能会有所不同。因此，随着新模型的发布，ROSE 作为指标的可靠性可能会发生波动。尽管此类更新为更强大的法官提供了与专家判断更紧密结合的机会，但它们也带来了跨版本漂移的风险。根据附录我们的版本管理策略, performance varies when different foundational models are used as the backbone for SQL Prover and Adversarial Refuter. Consequently, the reliability of ROSE as a metric may fluctuate as new models are released. Although such updates create an opportunity for stronger judges that align more closely with expert judgments, they also introduce a risk of drift across versions. Under our version management strategy in AppendixE，新模型被视为候选模型，在采用之前必须通过重新验证。, new models are treated as candidates that must pass re-validation before adoption.

共识过滤的选择偏差。Selection Bias from Consensus Filtering.ROSE-VEC 是通过仅保留两个注释者达成完全一致的情况来构建的。这减少了标签噪音并产生高置信度的验证集，但也可能引入选择偏差。特别是，保留的实例可能会过度代表具有更清晰解释或更容易语义判断的查询，而不足以代表边界、容易出现分歧或真正模棱两可的情况。因此，自动指标和专家标签之间报告的一致性可能无法完全反映 NL2SQL 输出更广泛分布的性能。ROSE-VEC is constructed by retaining only cases on which two annotators reach exact agreement. This reduces label noise and yields a high-confidence validation set, but it may also introduce a selection bias. In particular, retained instances may over-represent queries with clearer interpretation or easier semantic judgments, while under-representing borderline, disagreement-prone, or genuinely ambiguous cases. As a result, the reported agreement between automatic metrics and expert labels may not fully reflect performance on the broader distribution of NL2SQL outputs.

计算成本和延迟。Computational Cost and Latency.与执行准确度 (EX) 等确定性指标相比，ROSE 等基于 LLM 的指标更加消耗资源。与模型推理相关的计算开销和增加的延迟可能会限制在需要快速、迭代方法开发和测试的场景中使用 ROSE 的实用性，在这些场景中，即时反馈至关重要。 ROSE 通过调用路由、简洁提示和多线程并行性减轻了这种开销，但它仍然比确定性替代方案更昂贵。Compared to deterministic metrics such as Execution Accuracy (EX), LLM-based metrics like ROSE are substantially more resource-intensive. The computational overhead and increased latency associated with model inference may limit the practicality of using ROSE in scenarios requiring rapid, iterative method development and testing, where immediate feedback is crucial. ROSE mitigates this overhead through call routing, concise prompts, and multi-thread parallelism, but it remains more expensive than deterministic alternatives.

总结我们的贡献，表To summarize our contributions, Table5概述了 ROSE 和之前的评估指标之间的主要区别。这一比较凸显了现有方法从根本上受到对单一真实 SQL 的依赖的限制，而 ROSE 的设计目的是针对歧义和真实错误提供更强的鲁棒性，提供超越简单二进制分数的诊断功能。outlines the key differences between ROSE and prior evaluation metrics. The comparison highlights how existing methods are fundamentally limited by their reliance on a single ground-truth SQL, whereas ROSE is designed for greater robustness against ambiguity and ground-truth errors, offering diagnostic capabilities beyond a simple binary score.

E.1 命名约定Naming Convention

我们将每个实例化的 ROSE 法官表示为We denote each instantiated ROSE judge as玫瑰ROSEmodel-time{}_{\textit{model-time}}, 其中, where型号model是主干标识符并且is the backbone identifier and时间time是骨干发布月份is the backbone release month inyymm格式。例如，format. For example,玫瑰ROSEo3-2504{}_{\textit{o3-2504}}指的是2025年4月发布的o3主干网。所有报告的分数都应包含此版本标签，以使判断配置明确。refers to the o3 backbone released in April 2025. All reported scores should include this version tag to make the judge configuration explicit.

E.2 主干版本控制Backbone Versioning

基于 LLM 的指标对骨干模型的选择很敏感。由于基础模型发展迅速，频繁的模型更新可能会导致报告的分数出现偏差。然而，当更强的推理能力能够更好地与专家判断保持一致时，它们也为改进评估创造了机会。为了确保公共排行榜的公平比较，我们承诺在一定时期内建立统一的骨干网。LLM-based metrics are sensitive to the choice of backbone models. Because foundation models evolve rapidly, frequent model updates can introduce drift in reported scores. However, they also create an opportunity for improved evaluation when stronger reasoning capabilities yield better alignment with expert judgments. To ensure fair comparison for public leaderboards, we commit to a unified backbone within a given period.

通过根据 ROSE-VEC 验证协议，从候选主干中选择统一主干。当且仅当新候选者在 ROSE-VEC 上的所有四个指标上实现更好的验证性能时，我们才会更换统一主干：准确性、Cohen’sThe unified backbone is selected among candidate backbones by validating agreement against ROSE-VEC. We replace the unified backbone if and only if a new candidate achieves better validation performance on ROSE-VEC across all four metrics: Accuracy, Cohen’sκ\kappa、MCC 和 F1。这一要求促进了原则性的升级，同时防止任何个别方面的倒退。, MCC, and F1. This requirement promotes principled upgrades while preventing regressions in any individual aspect.

当默认裁判更新时，早期的分数仍然有效并被保留，但会标记为原始分数When the default judge is updated, earlier scores remain valid and are retained, but are tagged with their original玫瑰ROSEmodel-time{}_{\textit{model-time}}版本。新的评估会在新版本标签下发布。通过这种方式，法官的变更得到控制、记录和版本控制。version. New evaluations are published under the new version tag. In this way, judge changes are controlled, documented, and versioned.

Across both backbones, all ablated variants fall behind the full ROSE cascade, showing that removing ground-truth supervision or collapsing two stages into a single prompt both degrade agreement with expert judges. 附录一Appendix I误差分析Error Analysis

为了更好地了解 ROSE 失败的时间和原因，我们使用以下方法审核 ROSE 与 ROSE-VEC-BIRD 上的专家标签之间的所有分歧实例To better understand when and why ROSE fails, we audit all disagreement instances between ROSE and expert labels on ROSE-VEC-BIRD using玫瑰ROSEo3-2504{}_{\textit{o3-2504}}。在29个失败案例中，26个是假阴性，3个是假阳性（Q252、Q861、Q1487），这表明ROSE总体上是保守的，更有可能低估信用而不是高估信用。我们总结了观察到的故障模式如下。. Among 29 failure cases, 26 are false negatives and 3 are false positives (Q252, Q861, Q1487), suggesting that ROSE is generally conservative and more likely to under-credit than to over-credit. We summarize the observed failure modes below.

一、1I.1逻辑稳健性与巧合正确性Logical Robustness vs. Coincidental Correctness

这是主要模式，约占分歧的一半 (15/29)。 ROSE 会惩罚那些恰好在当前数据库状态下返回正确答案但在可能的数据变化下逻辑上脆弱的 SQL。This is the dominant pattern, accounting for roughly half of the disagreements (15/29). ROSE penalizes SQL that happens to return the correct answer on the current database state but is logically fragile under plausible data variations.

示例（Q137）。Example (Q137).

问题。Question.“有多少个账户在分支机构地点 1 拥有运行合同？”“How many accounts have running contracts in Branch location 1?”

预测的 SQL。Predicted SQL. SELECT COUNT(account.account_id) FROM 账户 INNER JOIN 贷款 ON account.account_id = Loan.account_id WHERE account.district_id = 1 AND (loan.status = 'C' OR Loan.status = 'D');SELECT COUNT(account.account_id) FROM account INNER JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id WHERE account.district_id = 1 AND (loan.status = ’C’ OR loan.status = ’D’);

分析。Analysis.该查询计算贷款行而不是不同的帐户。它与当前实例上的黄金答案相匹配，但一旦一个账户可以持有多个合约，它就会过度计算。即使执行与引用一致，ROSE 也会将其标记为逻辑上不安全。The query counts loan rows rather than distinct accounts. It matches the gold answer on the current instance, but it would over-count once an account can hold multiple contracts. ROSE flags this as logically unsafe even though execution coincides with the reference.

一、2I.2单位和格式务实严谨Pragmatic Rigidity in Units and Format

大约三分之一的分歧 (11/29) 源于对表示的严格性，包括单位、缩放比例和输出约定。注释者可以接受等效的表示，而 ROSE 则将其视为语义上不完整的。Around one third of the disagreements (11/29) arise from strictness about representation, including units, scaling, and output conventions. Annotators may accept a representation as equivalent, while ROSE treats it as semantically incomplete.

示例（Q77）。Example (Q77).

问题。Question.“洛杉矶县有哪些学校提供从幼儿园到 9 年级的年级，其合格 FRPM（5-17 岁）的百分比 (%) 是多少？”“Which schools served a grade span of Kindergarten to 9th grade in the county of Los Angeles and what is its Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5–17)?”

预测的 SQL。Predicted SQL. 选择学校.学校，frpm。“符合条件的 FRPM（5-17 岁）百分比 (%)”FROM 学校 INNER JOIN frpm ON school.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode WHERE schools.GSserved = 'K-9' AND schools.County = 'Los Angeles';SELECT schools.School, frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" FROM schools INNER JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode WHERE schools.GSserved = ’K-9’ AND schools.County = ’Los Angeles’;

分析。Analysis.查询返回一个存储的 FRPM 值，表示为The query returns a stored FRPM value represented as a proportion in[0,1][0,1]，而问题要求一个百分比。注释器接受比例形式直至确定的比例因子。 ROSE 将单位不匹配视为语义间隙并将其标记为不正确。, while the question requests a percentage. Annotators accept the proportional form up to a deterministic scaling factor. ROSE treats the unit mismatch as a semantic gap and marks it incorrect.

I.3 世界知识、模式启发法和歧义World Knowledge, Schema Heuristics, and Ambiguity

其余情况 (3/29) 是由领域解释、模式启发式或自然语言查询中的真正模糊性驱动的，其中多个读取是合理的，并且 ROSE 可能会比注释器强制执行更字面的解释。The remaining cases (3/29) are driven by domain interpretation, schema heuristics, or genuine ambiguity in the natural-language query, where multiple readings can be defensible and ROSE may enforce a more literal interpretation than annotators.

示例（Q82）。Example (Q82).

问题。Question.“经度最高的学校提供的年级跨度是多少？”“What is the grade span offered in the school with the highest longitude?”

预测的 SQL。Predicted SQL. 选择学校提供的 G 按 ABS（经度）DESC LIMIT 1 排序；SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC LIMIT 1;

分析。Analysis.查询按绝对经度排序，有效地选择距离本初子午线最远的学校。注释者认为这是对“最高经度”的合理解读。 ROSE 强制使用数值上最大的经度并将预测标记为不正确。The query orders by absolute longitude, effectively selecting the school farthest from the prime meridian. Annotators consider this a plausible reading of “highest longitude”. ROSE enforces the numerically largest longitude and marks the prediction as incorrect.

附录JAppendix JROSE-VEC-BIRD 和 ROSE-VEC-Spider 的结果Results on ROSE-VEC-BIRD and ROSE-VEC-Spider

J.1 指标有效性Metric effectiveness

我们在表中报告了 ROSE-VEC-BIRD 的分类结果We report disaggregated results for ROSE-VEC-BIRD in Table13和表中的 ROSE-VEC-Spiderand ROSE-VEC-Spider in Table14。在这两个子集上，确定性指标远远落后于基于 LLM 的评委，EX 始终强于 EM 和 ETM，但仍远未达到专家级别的一致性。在每个骨干网中，ROSE 在两个分支上都实现了最佳一致性和相关性。 ROSE w/o Refuter 和 ROSE 之间的比较突出了 refuter 阶段的贡献：ROSE 改进. On both subsets, deterministic metrics lag well behind LLM-based judges, with EX consistently stronger than EM and ETM but still far from expert-level agreement. Within each backbone, ROSE achieves the best agreement and correlation on both splits. The comparison between ROSE w/o Refuter and ROSE highlights the contribution of the refuter stage: ROSE improvesκ\kappa和 MCC 在两个子集上，尤其是在确定性信号最弱的 ROSE-VEC-Spider 上。唯一的例外是 Gemini-2.5 Pro 下的 ROSE-VEC-BIRD，其中 ROSE w/o Refuter 获得略高的 F1，而 ROSE 保持优异的协议导向分数。and MCC on both subsets, especially on ROSE-VEC-Spider where deterministic signals are weakest. The only exception is ROSE-VEC-BIRD under Gemini-2.5 Pro, where ROSE w/o Refuter attains slightly higher F1 while ROSE maintains superior agreement-oriented scores.

J.2 诊断有效性Diagnostic effectiveness

表格Tables12和and15报告 BIRD 和 Spider 切片上 ROSE 诊断标记的精确度。在两次测试中，OpenAI o3 都获得了 GoldX 和 AmbQ 的最高精度，Gemini-2.5 Pro 总体排名第二，DeepSeek-R1 落后。 Gemini-2.5 Pro 和 DeepSeek-R1 的 BIRD 上的 AmbQ 精度要低得多，这表明该领域的歧义问题检测具有挑战性。在Spider上，三个主干网都实现了更高的精度，AmbQ精度大幅提升，o3达到97.56%。总体而言，这些结果表明，当与强大的推理主干结合时，ROSE 会产生可靠的诊断标签，并且 Spider 分裂为诊断标记提供了比 BIRD 分裂更清洁的条件。report the precision of ROSE diagnostic labelling on the BIRD and Spider splits. On both splits, OpenAI o3 attains the highest precision for GoldX and AmbQ, with Gemini-2.5 Pro generally second and DeepSeek-R1 trailing. AmbQ precision is much lower on BIRD for Gemini-2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-R1, indicating that ambiguous-question detection is challenging in this domain. On Spider, all three backbones achieve higher precision and AmbQ precision rises sharply, with o3 reaching 97.56%. Overall, these results show that ROSE yields reliable diagnostic tags when coupled with strong reasoning backbones and that the Spider split provides cleaner conditions for diagnostic labelling than the BIRD split.

为了进一步说明执行准确性和我们的指标之间的差异，我们报告了每种方法的分数差距（ROSETo further illustrate the divergence between execution accuracy and our metric, we report the per-method score gaps (ROSE−-EX) 上EX) on鸟BIRD表中的迷你开发Mini-Dev in Table16。正差距表示 ROSE 认为正确但执行准确性受到惩罚的实例。我们观察到几个强大的系统（例如，GPT-4、GPT-4o）存在相当大的正差距，而一些微调模型则显示出较小甚至负的差距（例如，CodeS、RESDSQL），这突出表明纯执行信号何时会低估或高估语义正确性。. We observe sizable positive gaps for several strong systems (e.g., GPT-4, GPT-4o), while some fine-tuned models show small or even negative gaps (e.g., CodeS, RESDSQL), highlighting when pure execution signals can under- or over-estimate semantic correctness.

我们的专家注释者是五名计算机科学研究生，他们积极参与 NL2SQL 相关研究。每个注释者在这项工作之前至少参与过两个 NL2SQL 项目或研究论文，他们是根据之前的经验专门招募的。在注释之前，所有五位注释者共同讨论并迭代完善试点示例的标记指南，并完成了教程会议以确保对协议的一致理解。Our expert annotators are five graduate students in computer science who are actively involved in NL2SQL-related research. Each annotator has participated in at least two NL2SQL projects or research papers prior to this work, and they were recruited specifically on the basis of this prior experience. Before annotation, all five annotators jointly discussed and iteratively refined the labeling guidelines on pilot examples, and they completed a tutorial session to ensure consistent understanding of the protocol.
